Splatoon 1 erschien 2015 für die Wii U u: Splatoon 1 released in 2015 for the Wii U and invented the ink-shooter concept: as an Inkling you paint and swim through Inkopolis – Turf War was born.
Splatoon 2 kam 2017 zur Nintendo Switch: Splatoon 2 came to Nintendo Switch in 2017 and brought Salmon Run: for the first time, 4 players fought boss salmonids together for Grizzco.
Splatoon 3 erschien 2022: Neuer Schaupla: Splatoon 3 released in 2022: the new setting is Splatsville in the Splatlands – rougher, more desert-like and bigger than Inkopolis.
Neu in Teil 3 sind die Kalmar-Rolle (Sch: New in part 3 are the Squid Roll (deflect shots!) and the Squid Surge (rocket up walls) – the most important new competitive moves.
Salmon Run wurde in Teil 3 riesig ausgeb: Salmon Run was massively expanded in part 3: new bosses like Big Shot and Fish Stick, three King Salmonids (Cohozuna, Horrorboros, Megalodontia) and Big Run events on regular stages.
Viele Karten sind Rückkehrer: 7 stammen: Many stages are returning veterans: 7 come from Splatoon 1, 5 from Splatoon 2 – the map gallery above shows you which game each stage comes from.
